description: This file defines the TransactionRepository interface for accessing Transaction entities in a Spring Data repository. It extends CrudRepository and declares a custom method for finding transactions by account number.

classes.name: TransactionRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Transaction entities, enabling standard CRUD operations and a custom find method by account number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Method to retrieve an Optional list of Transactions filtered by account number.
